questions.solution: Apply the defined operations, rather than interpreting the signs as comparisons. First 1² + 2³ = 9. Then 9³ − 3² = 720.

questions.q: If you have a regular icosahedron and you slice it along a plane that intersects six of its faces, what is the shape of the resulting cross-section ?
questions.solution: Each intersected face contributes one side of the cross-section. Six intersected faces give a hexagon.

questions.q: A cylinder is intersected by a plane inclined at an angle of 45 degrees to its axis. What is the shape of the resulting cross-section?
questions.solution: A slanting plane cutting the curved surface of a cylinder produces an ellipse.

questions.q: If the sum of three consecutive even numbers is 78, what is the second largest number?
questions.solution: Write the numbers as x−2, x, x+2. Their sum is 3x = 78, giving x = 26.

questions.q: The simple interest on a certain sum of money for two years at 5% is ₹1,600. Find the compound interest at the same rate after 3 years, interest compounded annually.
questions.solution: Two years’ simple interest is 10% of the principal. Principal = 1600/0.10 = ₹16,000. Three years’ compound interest = 16000[(1.05)³−1] = ₹2,522.

questions.q: What is the discount on a pair of shoes marked at ₹475 and discounted at 15% ?
questions.solution: Discount = marked price × discount rate = 475×15/100 = ₹71.25.

questions.q: A shopkeeper allows a discount of 10% on the marked price of an item but charges a sales tax of 8% on the discounted price. If the customer pays ₹34,020 as the price including the sales tax, then what is the marked price?
questions.solution: The final price is 90%×108% = 97.2% of marked price. Marked price = 34020/0.972 = ₹35,000.

questions.q: If the average of $x$ and $\frac{1}{x}$ ($x \neq 0$) is $m$, then the average of $x^2$ and $\frac{1}{x^2}$ is:
questions.solution: Given x + 1/x = 2m, squaring gives x² + 1/x² + 2 = 4m². Divide the remaining sum by 2 to obtain 2m²−1.

questions.q: If the average of 9 consecutive even numbers is 132, find the difference between the first and the last numbers.
questions.solution: Nine consecutive even numbers have eight gaps of 2. The difference is 8×2 = 16.

questions.q: As a result of 25% hike in the price of rice per kg, a person is unable to purchase 6 kg more rice for ₹1,200. What was the original price of rice per kg?
questions.solution: Let the old quantity be q. A 25% price increase changes it to 4q/5, so q/5 = 6. Old quantity = 30 kg and old price = 1200/30 = ₹40.
Multiply all decimals by 100: 5,50,25,125 have HCF 5. Divide back by 100 to get 0.05.

questions.q: Find the smallest number which when divided by 4, 6, 7, 8 and 9 leaves the remainder 3 in each case.
questions.solution: LCM(4,6,7,8,9) = 504. Add the common remainder 3 to obtain 507 among the options.

questions.q: If the cost price of 30 tables is equal to the selling price of 40 tables, then what is the loss percentage ?
questions.solution: If one table costs c, then 40 selling prices equal 30c. Selling price per table is 3c/4, so loss is 25%.

questions.q: Nikhil and Reetu earn in the ratio 2: 1. They spend in the ratio 5: 3 and save in the ratio 4: 1. Find the monthly income of each, if the total monthly savings of both Nikhil and Reetu together is ₹10,000.
questions.solution: Savings are ₹8,000 and ₹2,000. Let incomes be 2x and x. Spending ratio gives (2x−8000)/(x−2000)=5/3. Hence x=14000.

questions.q: In an examination, a student who gets 20% of the maximum marks fails by 5 marks. Another student who scores 30% of the maximum marks, gets 20 marks more than the passing marks. The percentage required for passing is:
questions.solution: The score difference is 10% of the maximum and equals 25 marks. Maximum = 250. Pass marks = 50+5 = 55, or 22%.

questions.q: Two types of rice rates are ₹11/kg and ₹21/kg. Find the ratio of the two types of rice to obtain a mixture of rate ₹17/kg.
questions.solution: Alligation gives cheaper:dearer = (21−17):(17−11) = 4:6 = 2:3.

questions.q: Two trains travel in the same direction at 59 km/hr and 32 km/hr and the faster train passes a man in the slower train in 16 seconds. Find the length of the faster train.
questions.solution: Relative speed is 27 km/h = 7.5 m/s. Length = relative speed×time = 7.5×16 = 120 m.

questions.q: A 67 meters long train crosses a tunnel of length 33 meters in 10 seconds. Find the time for the train to cross a man standing on a platform of length 65 meters.
questions.solution: Speed = (67+33)/10 = 10 m/s. Passing a stationary man requires covering only the train’s own length: 67/10 = 6.7 seconds.

questions.q: Indian Railways employed 200 workers to complete a certain work in 150 days. If only one-fourth of the work had been done in 50 days, then to complete the whole work in time, what is the number of additional workers to be employed ?
questions.solution: A quarter of the work takes 200×50 = 10,000 worker-days. Remaining work needs 30,000 worker-days in 100 days. Required total is 300 workers, or 100 extra.

questions.q: 12 men and 18 women can do a work in 10 days. 9 men and 18 women can do the same work in 12 days. If 2 men and 3 women together do the same work, in how many days will they complete the work?
questions.solution: The group of 2 men and 3 women is exactly one-sixth of 12 men and 18 women. It therefore takes six times 10 days = 60 days.

questions.q: The average weight of A, B and C is 60 kg. If the average weight of A and B is 30 kg and that of B and C is 70 kg, then what is the weight of B?
questions.solution: A+B+C=180, A+B=60 and B+C=140. Add the last two sums and subtract 180 to get B=20 kg.

questions.q: A person sold a horse at a gain of 25%. Had he bought it for 35% less and sold it for 732 less, he would have made a profit of 36%. The cost price of the horse was:
questions.solution: Let cost be C. First selling price is 1.25C; alternative cost is 0.65C. Thus 1.25C−732=1.36×0.65C, giving C=2000.

questions.q: A bus travels a distance of 250 kilometers at a speed of 50 kilometers per hour. How much time will it take to complete the journey?
questions.solution: Time = distance/speed = 250/50 = 5 hours.
